thread:
harper: Short follow-up from the RFC: we need a concrete mapping strategy from lightweight probe metrics to full golden expectations. Posting proposed heuristics.

diego: Please spell out inputs and guarantees.

harper: Inputs: probe 99p latency, probe median latency, probe failure rate, kernel tag, quant_flag. Guarantee: predictor returns a conservative expected change with a confidence band.

anya: What's the model? Linear per-family? Nonlinear?

harper: Start linear per-model-family with L2 regularization. Features: log_latency_probe, delta_seed_warmup, kernel_onehot, quant_flag. Train on historical paired probe->golden runs.

pav: How do we avoid overfitting to old kernels? Need time-decay on data and signal for unseen kernels.

harper: Use exponential decay weight on samples (half-life = 30 days). For unseen kernel tags, fall back to family-level slope with an uncertainty penalty.

anya: Uncertainty penalty: can we quantify it as additive % on predicted delta? e.g., +3% if fewer than N samples.

harper: Exactly. Rule: if sample_count < 50, add 2.5% per missing log10(samples) down to a cap. Also require canary shadowing to validate predictions.

diego: What about adversarial hints? Teams might tune probes to look good but not generalize.

harper: Telemetry to the rescue: record seed, probe_variant, warmup_hint. If the same client always uses tiny warmup_hint, mark as high-risk and increase uncertainty.

pav: Rollout gating logic?

harper: Proposed gate: predicted golden 99p delta < +4% AND observed golden delta during canary < 2x predicted absolute change AND probe failure rate < 0.3%. If any fail, auto-roll back.

anya: Also include quality checks: golden perplexity delta < 0.4 and generation failure delta < 0.25%.

diego: How do we present this to oncall during canary? Short dashboard?

harper: Yes: single-pane view with columns: model, predicted_delta, observed_delta, sample_count, kernel, fallback_rate. Also show confidence band and flags (high-risk, unseen-kernel).

pav: Implementation owner? I can take the predictor service PR if harper writes the training harness.

harper: I'll draft the harness and initial model; pav owns the service + dashboard. I'll open tickets.

onboard-bot: Created MLON-7007 (probe->golden predictor) assigned to pav & harper. Reminder: canary-check-in @harper in 48h.

anya: One last detail: include raw probe hash in telemetry so we can detect drift without exposing data.

harper: Noted. I'll add `probe_sample_hash` and `probe_seed` fields. Thanks all.
